full_judgment: 2. The petitioner instituted the aforesaid Title Suit for permanent injunction against the opposite party No. 1 and 7 others in respect of 0.50 acres of land appertaining to CS Plot No. 389 of CS khatian No. 136 of mouza Lokuriapara restraining the defendants from entering upon the land in suit on various averments including the assertion that the plaintiff has been in possession of the land in suit :-on the basis of an order passed in a pre-emption case which he took on 9.7.1977 through Court. The defendant opposite party No. 1 herein before me contested the said suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint contending that he was in possession of the disputed land on the basis of purchase from one Ayesha Khatun and Mahmudul Hoque by kabala dated 26.6.74 through borgadar. After several adjournment the suit was ultimately fixed for peremptory hearing on 6.11.1980. On that date the defendant No.1 filed an application for adjournment of the hearing of the suit on the ground that he was engaged in his official duty. The learned Munsif rejected the petition for adjournment followed by filing another application for adjournment by the defendant No. 1 which met with the same result. Thereafter, the learned trial Court took up the suit for ex parte hearing and by an order dated 6.11.1980 decreed the suit ex parte.
